# The original EWS URL-stop helper overwrites the operation status with URI status

Original MessageOperationCallbacks::NotifyListener takes an operation rv, then shadows it with the FolderUri result inside the listener branch. A successful URI lookup therefore sends NS_OK even when OnError requested NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED. URI lookup failure returns before notification, and callers ignore that helper result. PromiseUrlListener resolves or rejects from the received code, so this status mix-up matters to callers even though new happy-path assertions inspect useful state. Later ExchangeFolder::SyncMessages passes its onSyncStop status directly to OnStopRunningUrl. This is an exact historical status-flow finding and later-source comparison, not a reproduced hang or proof every current error path completes.

Scope: mailnews/protocols/ews.
